reviews.comment: First test was brutal, but it's just because the class is hard. When he raises his voice in lecture it's because he's saying something he wants you to remember. He is super helpful during office hours, and while he does tell you he's disappointed in you, he really helps you learn. Got a 58 on the first test and 93 on the second. I think he's funny.
Great professor, very accessible in office hours, and he wants his students to be successful.

His class is quite brutal and very calculation heavy, but the tests are similar to the practice exam and hw questions, but with a lot shorter time. He can come off as rude and impatient, but he's pretty nice in office hours and if you make the effort to go to him when you need help, he's more than glad to help and he's nicer.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Jeong is the most inspirational man I know. He will inspire you to Q-drop his course, take off your aggie ring, and drive your car into a tree. The homework will take a minimum of 15 hours per week. The time constraints on the exam make it impossible to finish. In a class of 55, 20 qdropped, and he failed an additional 7.

95% of your grade is based on tests. The class average is 54%. Jeong doesn't really teach. His lectures are essentially long lists of formulas with zero explanation of practical application. He also treats students horribly. He told my class that we're going to blow up chemical plants and to move to North Korea to kill people there instead of here.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are naturally smart you'll be ok. If not smart NOOOO.
very tough grader, can't finish test in time and when you go to office hours he roasts you. It would be a better use of your time to not take this class until you can get another professor.

Dr. Jeong lectures very spiritedly and has some funny moments, but his "Aggie-Longhorn" examples are overused and he doesn't work through any problems. His exams are similar to the practice exams, but harder and within a time crunch. The first was graded very strictly, but he became more lenient with the later exams. Will help, but can be rude.

Jeong gets a lot of hate but overall he is a pretty good professor. His handwriting is awful but if you pay attention in lecture he goes over everything that will be tested and he is pretty good about explaining things. He was definitely much better for thermo 2 than for kinetics but was a decent professor overall if you just put in the work.

Worst CHEN364 professor by far. Narcissistic, rude to students who ask reasonable questions(in or outside of class), and grades like Hitler. Doesn't tell you what you missed, though, and just roasts you in office hours when you ask for help. Hope he reads this and decides to actually help students learn instead of belittling them.

Out of all the CHEN354 profs, Jeong is the best. Exams are just like the homework and in-class examples. He is super lenient with partial credit and his class is definitely much easier than any other thermo professor. The class is still tough, but it is much easier to get an A or pass than for other profs. Take if you can.

Dr. Jeong is a decent professor. Lectures aren't the greatest, but he is very enthusiastic and spirited. Thermo II is definitely challenging but he has clear expectations on what you should know. Exams are conceptually similar to homework, and he is VERY lenient with partial credit. Would definitely take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Despite being one of the hardest classes I have ever taken, Dr. Jeong was an alright prof. He gave practice exams that were similar to the actual exams (which were curved), and gave bonus point pop quizzes in class. Lectures aren't super helpful, and homework was unnecessarily long at times. Tries to connect his class to real job applications.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jeong is a professor that comes off as a little entitled. However, outside of class, he is much more approachable. He genuinely cares that you learn the material and if you put in the effort he notices. Does he like to admit that you might be wrong, yes. But these professors have high expectations. Overall, I would take Dr. Jeong again.

Every time I talked to this professor I was disrespected. He preaches partial credit, but fails to give any if you get the final answer wrong. Everyone I know that goes to lecture hardly take notes as he goes too fast and doesn't go through examples well. Everything I have learned has been through the textbook. He enjoys telling you you're wrong.

Dr. Jeong is a good professor. His lectures tend to be equation-dense, but he is extremely helpful in office hours. He is very friendly and funny. Was the class easy? No. Did I learn a lot? Yes. He tends to have a bad reputation as a professor, but I really don't know why. I took him for Thermo I and for Kinetics. He is a solid prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy
